study type: Register description and descriptive cross-sectional analysis
cohort: The study describes data from the Swedish Pregnancy Register, covering over 90% of all deliveries in Sweden.
finding: The report indicates that the quality of antenatal and delivery care in Sweden varies significantly between regions.
cross-section timing: Data collected from the first antenatal visit until 8-16 weeks postpartum, aiming to include all deliveries within 2018.
